additions.name: Datrix LIM1, Santiago de Surco — existing colocation operations

status.summary: A commercial presence filing dated November 20, 2026 confirms service at the Manuel Olguín facility. The operator lists it as its existing LIM1 property.

locator.precision: Representative point inside the mapped building at the operator’s published property.
locator.identity_review: The named OpenStreetMap footprint encloses the native marker on Datrix’s LIM1 property page. The commercial address and TÜV certificate match this facility.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The source gives no numerical positional accuracy for this mapped footprint.

additions.distinctness_review: The registered site is at Avenida Manuel Olguín 395. Equinix LM1 is at Calle Centauro 115. Additional provider listings at Manuel Olguín 395 share the Datrix host property. The nearest previous record, Equinix LM1, Calle Centauro 115, Lima, is 224 metres away. Six release layers were checked for the property and address aliases.
additions.successor_review: Cirion and Datrix are successive brands for this same facility. The registered site is at Avenida Manuel Olguín 395. Equinix LM1 is at Calle Centauro 115. Additional provider listings at Manuel Olguín 395 share the Datrix host property.

additions.name: Open DC PE2 — existing colocation operations

status.summary: On November 6 Open DC reported that it operated the PE2 data centre in Bayan Lepas Industrial Park, Penang.

locator.method: Calculate the area centroid of OpenStreetMap way 262514310 version 3 in WGS 84 / UTM zone 47N and transform it to WGS 84 longitude and latitude.
locator.precision: Representative point on the published campus property at Lot 17001, Medan Bayan Lepas.
locator.identity_review: Open DC gives Lot 17001, Medan Bayan Lepas as the PE2 address. The seller identifies that lot in the sale to Open DC PE2 Asset. The mapped industrial building bears the same lot, street, city and postcode under the former industrial occupant’s name.
locator.uncertainty_reason: OpenStreetMap publishes no measured positional error for this building. Its historical outline identifies the campus address.

additions.distinctness_review: No PE2 or Lot 17001 campus alias matches a canonical project, site, historical identity or imported source record. Open DC lists PE1 separately at Menara Suntech. The nearest published site is Google Data Center, Elmina Business Park, 266.9 km away.
additions.successor_review: The November 13, 18 and 24 operator publications describe colocation customers, first-phase commitments and energised power respectively. The 100 MW target is a phased campus plan. These updates identify no additional completed project or opening date.

additions.name: Uniserve VAN-2, Vancouver — initial buildout

status.summary: Uniserve’s September 28 management report confirms that construction of the initial facility at 369 Terminal Avenue was complete. Its October disclosures give differing timetables for commercial launch and initial operating capacity.

locator.precision: Municipal parcel-display point for the host property. The lease covers a portion of its commercial space.
locator.identity_review: The project release and executed lease summary both identify 369 Terminal Avenue. The municipal address register returns a single record for that address.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The City of Vancouver publishes no numerical accuracy for this individual parcel-display point.

additions.distinctness_review: The municipal register distinguishes 369 Terminal Avenue from the separately addressed parcel at 333 Terminal Avenue. The nearest existing atlas property is Cologix VAN4 Data Centre, Vancouver (175 West Cordova Street), 1620 metres away.
additions.successor_review: Uniserve’s filing distinguishes VAN-2 from its existing Vancouver facility and from a possible future expansion. This record covers the initial buildout of the leased premises at 369 Terminal Avenue.

additions.name: Uniserve, 333 Terminal Avenue, Vancouver — existing colocation operations

status.summary: In its October 30 filing, Uniserve describes operating its established Vancouver data center separately from VAN-2. The property’s leasing agent identifies the established colocation facility at 333 Terminal Avenue.

locator.precision: Municipal civic address point for the host property. The data center occupies part of the commercial building.
locator.identity_review: The agent’s building-specific brochure expressly identifies Uniserve’s colocation facility at 333 Terminal Avenue. The issuer reports a continuing facility lease with 333 Terminal Holdings Ltd. and distinguishes the existing building from its VAN-2 project.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The city publishes no numerical accuracy for this individual parcel-display point.

additions.distinctness_review: The existing colocation site has a separate registered property address and a different municipal parcel from VAN-2 at 369 Terminal Avenue. The nearest baseline facility is Cologix VAN4 Data Centre, Vancouver (175 West Cordova Street), 1554 metres away.
additions.successor_review: The operator distinguishes the earlier Vancouver data center and its later VAN-2 buildout. The leasing agent identifies the existing site inside 333 Terminal Avenue.
